subject: Scope confirmation: SOC 2 Type II period and targeted auth trace request
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@veritasaudit.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@hearthsidebio.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and targeted auth trace asks for audit window

Hi Jonas,

We’re onboarding Redwood as a critical vendor for Hearthside Bio’s 2026 audit. To complete our control testing we need the SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 and a bridge letter for any gaps or subsequent control changes. In addition to the report, please provide the following targeted artifacts (these are required for our sampling):

- MFA push success/fail logs for a rolling 30-day slice within the audit period (we’ll need UTC timestamps, user_id or email, auth_method, result).
- A session/token retention trace for service accounts (one week sample, preferably July 12–18, 2026) showing token issuance and termination events.
- Evidence of quarterly privileged access reviews performed during the period (access review export or summary plus reviewer sign-off).
- Any planned or completed keystore rotation records for production (dates and PR/CL references).

We consider these targeted extracts (not full dumps). Please confirm whether you can deliver CSV slices for the first two artifacts and a short summary bundle for the others by Aug 16, 2026. If you cannot meet that date, propose an alternative and let us know what limitations we should document in the audit workpapers.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Senior Information Security Auditor
Veritas Audit Services

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Emma Li <emma.li@veritasaudit.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and targeted auth trace asks for audit window

Emma — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the Type II PDF and a bridge letter draft quickly; the targeted slices require coordination with Engineering and Security.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope the extracts correctly:
1) For the MFA slice, do you want only interactive user MFA (push/TOTP) or also service-to-service token exchanges that may include "MFA bypass" events?
2) For the session traces, is the July 12–18 week you suggested a hard requirement or an example window? We can extract multiple contiguous windows if you want coverage across the period.
3) For privileged access reviews, do you need raw attestation exports or a redacted summary showing dates, reviewer, and outcome?

I’ve looped in Olga from Security and Laura from Compliance to confirm extraction capability and ETA. Our intended delivery plan: SOC 2 PDF + bridge draft by Aug 12, targeted CSV slices by Aug 18 if Engineering has no blocking issues. Will confirm once Olga responds.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and targeted auth trace asks for audit window

Olga / Laura — forwarding Emma's request (below). High priority for Hearthside Bio (HubSpot HSB-4773). Requested delivery: SOC2 PDF + bridge letter by Aug 12, CSV slices by Aug 16–18.

Also need an attestation summary for privileged access reviews and any keystore rotation records.

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-10T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and targeted auth trace asks for audit window

Jonas / Laura — security can handle the extracts with the following plan and caveats:

Planned deliverables and ETA:
- SOC 2 Type II full report (PDF): redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf — ready by 2026-08-12 EOD.
- Bridge letter (draft): bridge_letter_draft_2026.docx — delivered 2026-08-12 for review; final after sign-off.
- MFA push slice (30 days): mfa_push_slices.csv — includes utc_ts, user_email (hashed if requested), auth_method, result, device_id (optional) — target delivery 2026-08-18.
- Session/token traces for service accounts (one-week sample): session_token_traces.csv — includes utc_ts, principal, token_id (truncated), event_type (issue/refresh/revoke), source_ip — target delivery 2026-08-18.
- Privileged access review summary: privileged_access_review_summary.pdf — exported reviewer, date, outcome, comments (redacted PII) — target delivery 2026-08-16.
- Keystore rotation log: keystore_rotation_notes.txt — list of rotation dates and internal change refs — included with summary.

Caveats / notes:
- Retention: raw auth logs older than 90 days are archived and require an additional extraction step (we have 12 months of event indexes but full payloads for only 90 days). If Emma needs a window outside of the fast-retention window we will schedule a one-off archival restore (additional 2–3 business days).
- Pseudonymization: by default we will hash user emails; if Hearthside requires full emails we need explicit written consent (security/privacy requirement).
- Small sample changes: if July 12–18 is not within the fast window, security will propose the closest week and document the reason in the bridge letter/workpaper.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether Emma accepts hashed user identifiers in the CSVs or requires cleartext.
2) Confirm whether July 12–18 is required or if we should pick the most recent full week inside the 90-day fast-retention window.

I’ll start the extraction job once we get a confirmation on those two points.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

- 2026-08-16: privileged_access_review_summary.pdf and keystore_rotation_notes.txt.

Attachments included in this message: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf, bridge_letter_draft_2026.docx. CSV slices and summaries will follow as separate encrypted attachments (or secure Drive links) on the target dates above.
